summary: The resource reporting query file goes at extensions/audit/event_query.yml in the collection root, the standard location for embedded queries.
questions: Where does the resource reporting query file live in a collection?

answer_card.title: Location of the query file
answer_card.answer_md:
Create `extensions/audit/event_query.yml` at the collection root:
```text
my_namespace/my_collection/
├── extensions/audit/event_query.yml
├── plugins/
├── meta/
└── galaxy.yml
```
